nvidia/vllm.note: Pinned CUDA 12.8 environment; compatible driver required. Native dependencies differ from ROCm and TT.

nvidia/sglang.note: SGLang dependency baseline differs from vLLM; compare frameworks as a stack change.

amd/vllm.note: Official vLLM 0.17.1 ROCm 7.0 wheels use PyTorch 2.9.1, unlike NVIDIA's 2.10.0. Cross-vendor comparisons include that software difference. MI210 model/kernel support requires host validation.

amd/sglang.note: Match NVIDIA upstream releases with ROCm builds. MI210 support requires host validation; do not replace vendor native wheels with CUDA wheels.

tenstorrent/vllm.note: TT plugin compatibility baseline requires a different vLLM/PyTorch release. Cross-vendor comparisons include software/kernel/precision changes, not hardware alone.
